findings.title: AWS Access Key Exposed in Environment
findings.message: An AWS access key (REDACTED_aws_key_example) was found set as an environment variable. This credential is visible to all processes on the system and may appear in crash dumps or logs.

findings.title: OpenAI API Key Exposed in Environment
findings.message: An OpenAI API key (REDACTED_openai_key_example) was found in the environment. This key can be used to make API calls billed to your account.

findings.title: Git SSL Verification Disabled
findings.message: Git is configured with http.sslVerify=false in the global config. This disables TLS certificate validation for all Git operations, exposing credentials and code to MITM attacks.

findings.title: npm Auth Token in .npmrc
findings.message: An npm authentication token was found in /Users/testuser/.npmrc. This token grants publish access to npm packages associated with this account.

findings.title: SSH Private Key Without Passphrase
findings.message: An SSH private key at /Users/testuser/.ssh/id_rsa is not protected by a passphrase. If this file is stolen, the key can be used immediately without any additional credentials.
